name: ND Disk Cleaner
description: Scan a folder or drive to see what is using space: a zoomable sunburst of the biggest items, a sortable list, reveal in Finder/Explorer, and move selected items to the trash. Fully external — installed on demand, nothing ships in the app bundle.

commands.description: Scan a folder or drive and clean up the biggest space hogs.
